title: Celigo mcp-oauth-provider
description:
Request body for creating or updating an MCP OAuth provider. On PUT,
this is a full replacement; include all fields you want to keep because
omitted optional fields are cleared.

name.description: Display name for the OAuth provider.

examples: Production Auth0 tenant for MCP servers

issuerURL.description: OAuth 2.0 issuer URL. Must include `http://` or `https://` scheme. Bare hostnames are rejected.

audience.description: Expected `aud` claim on incoming access tokens.

scopes.description: Required OAuth scopes. Incoming tokens must carry every listed scope.

useIntrospection.description: When `true`, opaque access tokens are validated via the issuer's RFC 7662 introspection endpoint using `clientId`/`clientSecret`. When `false`, only JWT tokens validated against JWKS are accepted.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID for token introspection. Required when `useIntrospection` is `true`.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret for introspection. Masked as `"******"` in responses; sending the masked value on PUT leaves it unchanged.
